peer_identity.arc_label: Bald scarred Metabaron who is Tonto and Lothar's master throughout the frame narrative
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Bald; distinctive scar over right eyebrow (origin deliberately withheld—'deplorable episode'). Self-described as 'a warrior without a past in the new galaxy.' Forceful, impatient with robot reasoning. Ruthlessly security-conscious: destroyed loyal servants to prevent enemies learning his secret. Calls robots his 'only friends.' Operates in another dimension; returns only for combat. Bio-electrogram manifestation dissolves in ~3 minutes.
peer_identity.rationale: Both records describe the same bald figure who is Tonto and Lothar's current master. Vol03 shows the bald Metabaron manifesting as a bio-electrogram during the Metabunker assault. Vol12 shows the bald Metabaron with the right-eyebrow scar destroying the Metabunker and departing to another dimension—explicitly identified as 'the last of the Metabarons.' Tonto references the eyebrow scar mystery in vol07/11 as a deferred story topic, placing this character as the frame narrative's anchor throughout. This is Aghora's son No-Name.
